statements.label: supported
statements.text: Several HERV-Fc1 genomic loci carried active chromatin signatures that were associated with Tau.
statements.evidence: we detect Tau-associated, active chromatin signatures at multiple HERV-Fc1 genomic loci
statements.note: The abstract reports Tau-associated active chromatin signatures at multiple HERV-Fc1 genomic loci.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: RNA sequencing of 636 human brains gave evidence of globally increased transcription of transposable elements in the long interspersed nuclear element 1 and endogenous retrovirus clades.
statements.evidence: 636 human brains, we discover differential expression for several retrotransposons in association with neurofibrillary tangle burden and highlight evidence for global TE transcriptional activation among the long interspersed nuclear element 1 and endogenous retrovirus clades.
statements.note: In the 636-brain RNA-seq data the abstract highlights global TE transcriptional activation, that is increased transcription, among the LINE-1 and endogenous retrovirus clades.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: Pharmacologically blocking retrotransposon activity in Tau-expressing Drosophila reduced the loss of neurons.
statements.evidence: Our results implicate TE activation and associated genomic instability in Tau-mediated AD mechanisms.
statements.note: The abstract implicates TE activation in Tau-mediated mechanisms but describes no experiment that blocks retrotransposons or measures neuron loss.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: In Drosophila expressing human wild-type or mutant Tau, retrotransposon responses were heterogeneous, with Tau-driven activation of TE expression depending on fly age and genotype.
statements.evidence: we profile retrotransposons in Drosophila expressing human wild-type or mutant Tau throughout the brain. We discover heterogeneous response profiles, including both age- and genotype-dependent activation of TE expression by Tau.
statements.note: In the Drosophila experiments the abstract reports heterogeneous retrotransposon responses that include age- and genotype-dependent activation of TE expression by Tau.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: Centromeres with the same satellite and ATHILA organisation as Col-CEN were also found in other flowering plant species.
statements.evidence: We propose that Arabidopsis centromeres are evolving through cycles of satellite homogenization and retrotransposon-driven diversification.
statements.note: The abstract's findings and proposal concern Arabidopsis centromeres only and make no comparison with other plant species.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: In the Col-CEN assembly, all five Arabidopsis thaliana centromeres were resolved and found to be megabase-scale tandem satellite arrays bearing chromosome-specific satellite variants.
statements.evidence: resolves all five centromeres. The centromeres consist of megabase-scale tandemly repeated satellite arrays, which support CENTROMERE SPECIFIC HISTONE H3 (CENH3) occupancy and are densely DNA methylated, with satellite variants private to each chromosome.
statements.note: The assembly resolves all five centromeres, which consist of megabase-scale tandem satellite arrays with satellite variants private to each chromosome.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Crossover recombination was suppressed within the centromeres, although meiotic DNA double-strand breaks still formed there at low levels under the control of DNA methylation.
statements.evidence: Centromeric crossover recombination is suppressed, yet low levels of meiotic DNA double-strand breaks occur that are regulated by DNA methylation.
statements.note: The abstract reports suppressed centromeric crossover recombination alongside low levels of meiotic double-strand breaks regulated by DNA methylation.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Satellites with lower divergence and higher-order repeat organisation were the preferred sites of CENTROMERE SPECIFIC HISTONE H3 (CENH3) occupancy.
statements.evidence: CENH3 preferentially occupies satellites that show the least amount of divergence and occur in higher-order repeats.
statements.note: The abstract states that CENH3 preferentially occupies the least-divergent satellites that occur in higher-order repeats, i.e. those with lower divergence.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Using physical maps of nine of the most diverse genomes, the study showed that transposons and other structural variants mould the epigenome and strongly affect immunity genes.
statements.evidence: Physical maps for nine of the most diverse genomes reveal how transposons and other structural variants shape the epigenome, with dramatic effects on immunity genes.
statements.note: The abstract reports that physical maps of nine of the most diverse genomes reveal transposons and structural variants shaping the epigenome, with dramatic effects on immunity genes.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: The geographic origin of Arabidopsis thaliana accessions was a key predictor of their genome-wide DNA methylation levels and of epiallele-driven changes in gene expression.
statements.evidence: geographic origin is a major predictor of genome-wide DNA methylation levels and of altered gene expression caused by epialleles
statements.note: The abstract names geographic origin as a major predictor of genome-wide DNA methylation levels and of gene expression altered by epialleles.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Comparison with cistrome and epicistrome data revealed links among transcription factor binding sites, DNA methylation, nucleotide variation and co-expression modules.
statements.evidence: Comparison to cistrome and epicistrome datasets identifies associations between transcription factor binding sites, methylation, nucleotide variation, and co-expression modules.
statements.note: The abstract reports that this comparison identifies associations between transcription factor binding sites, methylation, nucleotide variation and co-expression modules.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: Methylation epialleles were found to raise the fitness of Arabidopsis thaliana accessions in their native local environments.
statements.evidence: Because epigenetic variation can impact transcription and thus phenotypes, it may contribute to adaptation.
statements.note: The abstract raises adaptation only as a motivating possibility and reports no measurement of fitness or local adaptation.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: The extensive genomic variation between HFTH1 and the Golden Delicious reference genome is mainly explained by transposable element activity.
statements.evidence: We reveal that these extensive genomic variations are largely attributable to activity of transposable elements.
statements.note: The abstract attributes these extensive genomic variations, found relative to Golden Delicious, largely to transposable element activity.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: The HFTH1 genome assembly contains more annotated protein-coding genes than the Golden Delicious reference genome.
statements.evidence: Here, we assemble a high-quality genome (contig N50 of 6.99 Mb) of the apple anther-derived homozygous line HFTH1, including 22 telomere sequences
statements.note: The abstract reports assembly contiguity and telomeres but gives no gene count or gene-content comparison with Golden Delicious.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: A red-skinned apple phenotype was associated with an LTR retrotransposon inserted upstream of MdMYB1, a core transcriptional activator of anthocyanin biosynthesis.
statements.evidence: a long terminal repeat (LTR) retrotransposon insertion upstream of MdMYB1, a core transcriptional activator of anthocyanin biosynthesis, is associated with red-skinned phenotype
statements.note: The abstract reports that an LTR retrotransposon insertion upstream of MdMYB1 is associated with the red-skinned phenotype.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Relative to the Golden Delicious reference genome, HFTH1 had more deletions (18,047) than insertions (12,101), as well as 14 large inversions.
statements.evidence: In comparison to the Golden Delicious reference genome, we identify 18,047 deletions, 12,101 insertions and 14 large inversions.
statements.note: Against Golden Delicious the abstract lists 18,047 deletions, 12,101 insertions and 14 large inversions, so deletions outnumber insertions.
